# LinkedIn Profile Finder

> Give a person's name and company. You get the matching LinkedIn profile URL when the match is exact. A weak guess is not returned as a profile.

Mawsool publishes this as an Apify Actor. Starting from $0.40 per 1,000 name lookups.

## Run

- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-finder
- Call: `oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-finder`
- API key: https://mawsool.tech/ and https://docs.mawsool.tech/
- Contact: osama@mawsool.tech, info@mawsool.tech

## Use it when

You have a name and a company, and you do not have the LinkedIn URL yet.

## Use something else when

You have an email. Use Reverse Email Lookup. You already have a URL that 404s. Use Fix Broken LinkedIn URLs. A miss there is free.

## Page

- Find a LinkedIn profile from a name and company: docs/find-linkedin-by-name-and-company.md

Mawsool is not affiliated with LinkedIn.
